text:
Jules Rivera: Quick ping  I'm opening a small PR to refresh the quickstart 'hello' tutorial: normalize env var to REDWOOD_KEY, add PowerShell and python examples, and reorder Dockerfile for layer caching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2561
Marcus Holt: Can you paste the two-line migration note you'll include? Ops teams want a grep-friendly snippet.
Jules Rivera: Will add a compact diff for node + python users:

- node (old)
- const client = new Client(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
+ node (new)
+ import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
+ const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })

- python (old)
- client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
+ python (new)
+ from redwood import Redwood
+ client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))

Asha Kapoor: Nice. For curl, include bash and PowerShell variants and make sure examples use the x-api-key header. Also add a Troubleshooting mini-table: 401 -> missing key, 403 -> scope, 429 -> rate limit.
Jules Rivera: Adding those. Bash curl:

curl -H "x-api-key: $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

PowerShell:
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -Method Post -Headers @{"x-api-key" = $env:REDWOOD_KEY} -Body (@{input = "hi"} | ConvertTo-Json)

Marcus Holt: On Docker, copy package.json first and run npm ci in a deps stage, then copy node_modules into final image. Keeps installs cached. I tested cold build time down ~40%.
preview-bot: preview build started for PR 2561.
Asha Kapoor: I'll do an editorial pass after preview. Also request we put the SDK migration note behind a collapsible summary so the quickstart stays concise.
preview-bot: preview ready: https://deploy-preview-2561--docs.redwood.ai
Jules Rivera: Thanks all  pushing final tweaks and will merge after editorial signoff.
